# QuickOps 快维

> QuickOps 快维 is an open-source, Agno-powered AI operations assistant for single-node and intranet environments. It combines AI conversations, one persistent Shell per conversation, live host telemetry, four permission levels, human-in-the-loop approvals, command auditing, and offline Linux deployment.

Canonical project: https://github.com/bobo-study/QuickOps

Canonical name: QuickOps 快维. The user-facing assistant is named 小维 (Xiaowei). The project is maintained by 动感光波 (@bobo-study) under the Apache License 2.0.

Current scope: v0.0.1 is an early preview for a single operator managing the machine on which QuickOps runs. The offline installer targets Linux x86_64. Runtime host observation adapters support Linux, macOS, and Windows. QuickOps is not currently a multi-tenant fleet-management platform.
